page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard2.2 is an x86_64 compute instance designed for balanced enterprise workloads requiring higher memory capacity per core. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8167M processor running at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz, the instance delivers 4 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core. System memory is configured at 30.0 GB of RAM, providing an allocation ratio of 7.5 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware capabilities omit integrated acceleration and onboard physical disks, featuring 0 GPUs and no bundled local storage. Storage operations rely entirely on remote network-attached block volumes. Network configuration includes 1 complimentary public IPv4 address. Architectural extensions such as AVX, AVX-512, AMX, AES, and hardware cryptographic suites are absent or disabled according to instance feature reporting.

From an operational perspective, VM.Standard2.2 functions as a middle-tier general-purpose compute instance with higher-than-average memory density. While lacking local NVMe storage speeds and specialized compute acceleration instructions, it provides dedicated CPU scheduling and sufficient memory allocation to support sustained background services, enterprise application tiers, moderate caching layers, and web server workloads that fit within standard memory profiles.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard2.2 is a general-purpose cloud instance configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 30.0 GB of system RAM. Driven by an Intel Xeon 8167M x86_64 processor operating at 2.0 GHz across 2 physical cores, it offers a memory distribution of 7.5 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated GPU hardware, and local disk storage is not present, requiring external block storage for persistent data. Network provisioning includes 1 complimentary public IPv4 address. Advanced vector execution and hardware-assisted cryptographic flags are unavailable on the CPU profile. With its higher memory-to-vCPU ratio compared to typical standard instances, VM.Standard2.2 is appropriate for running enterprise applications, intermediate-scale web services, moderate caching nodes, and database deployments that do not demand local high-speed NVMe storage.
